name: mt4-gateway
description: MT4 gateway: Express API on top of a MetaTrader4 terminal running the MetaTrader4Bridge ZeroMQ EA (under Wine).

comments.zeromq: Pinned to the exact version metatrader4@1.0.5 requires (it uses zeromq/v5-compat). If the native build fails on Node 20, install build tools (python3 make g++) - the Dockerfile does - or try an override to a newer 6.x.
